title: An authored revision that runtime-band sources do not move: body(K), the packet, the host note and retention read it
summary: @inventarch/graph exports authoredRevisionOf(registry, inputs, derived?) beside revisionOf: the same SHA-256 over the same inputs without the sources at runtime placement (band 0), each runtime-placed input whose path derived names (a derived revision-only input no record compiles from) kept, and the registry, language version and kernel digest hashed as revisionOf hashes them; with no other source at runtime placement it equals revisionOf, and load and Graph.revision are unchanged. @inventarch/db readers and handles add authoredRevision (the root view's), previousAuthoredRevision and capturedAuthoredRevision, and Snapshot adds authoredRevision (the read view's); each keeps the .ia/.db-inputs.json input and the view registry, so a folder, floor-origin, authored-root or activation change still moves it, as does a source at runtime placement that adds a system folder or declares a `@system` or `@schema`, and with no source at runtime placement it equals revision, so a workspace with none keeps every revision and digest it had. revision keeps its meaning for scopes, revision read bindings (IA-DB-STALE), draft previews and the cache. Retention now keys on the authored revision: the previous snapshot is the most recent one whose authored revision differs, so a change to runtime-band sources alone rotates nothing, in a handle, in a new handle or in the capture pair writeCapture and planCapture keep; and a capture is trusted by its authored revision and the identity, band and digest of the membership rows of its records not at runtime placement, so one that differs from the fresh snapshot only in runtime-band rows, or in the roots a runtime-band `@workspace` declares, stays current. ia-snapshot-1 documents gain an optional authoredRevision key, which @inventarch/cli's ia capture now writes; a document without it names its revision as its authored revision, a malformed one is no capture, the format name is unchanged, and ia capture --json keeps its keys while its text now says the previous capture moved or was kept because the authored revision changed or did not; ia position's freshness line now names the capture's revision as its authored revision. Breaking: @inventarch/runtime's body(K) revision (the format keeps its name, ia.position-body.v1), the position packet's revision and provenance revision, renderHost's ia-generated line, the consumer skill's Source revision and the receipt's revision, the delivery view's revision, and the host note's revision, capturedRevision and previousRevision, and so its freshness, are now authored revisions, so a source at runtime placement that adds no system folder and declares no `@system` or `@schema` moves none of them while handle.revision moves; executeOwned takes the authored revision as its base, refusing with IA-EXEC-SOURCE-CHANGED only when it moves, and returns it as baseRevision. Limits: the nine version 1 Door routes keep the full revision and byte-identical output (the version 1 records operation leaves authoredRevision out), and MACHINE_PROTOCOL versions 1 and 2 and ia scope are unchanged; admission's findings and the database's seat and root decisions still read every placement, so a runtime-band record that an authored loaded record names can still move a body's unknowns, and one that changes which authored records are admitted (one repeating an authored requirement id refuses both) leaves a capture untrusted, no-capture, until the next ia capture; and `ia validate` and `ia-distribution validate` now write .ia/work/evidence/<authoredRevision>.ia at runtime placement, which only a reader opened with evidence lists and no shipped reader opens that way, so for every shipped reader only the locations override places a source there.
